SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. I. D. REGISTRY No. I. O. D. 51K. Louza Station. Date 27th Aug 1938.）
Subject (in full) Results of inquiries re attached note.
Grant
Made by D. S. I. White. Forwarded by
a/D.S.I.
Sir,
From personal inquiries I am satisfied that A. H. W. Grant mentioned in attached note is a young man of medium build and fair hair whom I have known for approximately one year. He speaks very good Chinese and was regularly to be found at night time in one or other of the Chinese cabarets in the Louza District, his favourite resort being the 'Black bat' cabaret, Thibet Road, (now closed.). With the exception of D. S. O'Rourke, the people in his company were always Chinese. One of Grant's regular companions was a man named Ajong Ah Lung, master of a furniture shop at (P) 221 Hankow Road and a person of very uncertain character. I can not trace any recent visit by members of the C. I. D. to any room in the Oriental Hotel, but from very good authority I have learned that 'Grant' keeps room No 523 in the Oriental Hotel, same being opened in the name of his friend 'aju' a bank employee. On one of the few times I met 'Grant' and had a talk with him he gave me quite a long explanation as to his personal uses of opium and the effects re sexual pleasures. I have also ascertained from Chinese whom I have seen in his company that he sometimes takes a 'smoke'.
I am, Sir,
Your Obediently,
S. White. D. S. I.
Louza.
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事侦缉处 登记室 编号 I. O. D. 51K。老闸捕房。日期：1938年8月27日。）
事由（全称）：关于附注所询事项之调查结果。
格兰特（Grant）
由副督察长怀特（D. S. I. White）作出。经由
代理副督察长转呈

先生，
经本人亲自查访，我确信附注中提及的 A. H. W. 格兰特是一名身材中等、金发的青年，我认识他已约一年之久。他中文讲得非常好，夜间常出没于老闸区的一家或另一家华人歌舞厅，他最爱去的是西藏路“黑蝙蝠”歌舞厅（现已关闭）。除了副督察长奥罗克（D. S. O'Rourke）之外，与他为伴者均为华人。格兰特的常客之一是一名叫阿龙（Ajong Ah Lung）的男子，系汉口路221号（P）一家家具店的老板，此人人品极为可疑。我未能查到刑事侦缉处人员近期曾探访东方饭店任何房间的记录，但据可靠消息来源获悉，“格兰特”在东方饭店包有523号房间，该房间是以其朋友“阿朱”（aju，一名银行职员）的名义开立的。在我与“格兰特”少数几次会面并交谈中，他曾就个人吸食鸦片及其对性快感的影响向我作了 lengthy 的解释。我还从与其为伴的华人处证实，他有时确实会“抽一口”。

此致，
敬礼，
S. 怀特。副督察长。
老闸。

POLICE FORCE,

Shanghai, AUG 23 1929 192
To a/ D.C.I.

Mr Stephen calls and states
that it has come to his
ears that a young man
employed by him named
A. H. W. Grant was
found in the Oriental
Hotel smoking opium
when members of the C.I.D
had occasion to visit
the Hotel about 2 weeks ago.
He asks to be informed
confidentially if this is so
or not. If true he proposes
pages.zh:

工部局，
上海，1929年8月23日 192
致 代理首席督察长

斯蒂芬（Stephen）先生来访并称，
他获悉，约两周前，
当刑事侦缉处人员
因事造访东方饭店时，
发现其雇用的一名
名叫
A. H. W. 格兰特的青年
正在该饭店
吸食鸦片。
他请求秘密告知
此事是否属实。若属实，他拟
